title: SynapseIDS · Neural Network
description: Reported training progress, model registry, dataset inventory and live inference performance.

options.content:
## From training evidence to live inference
**DATASETS → TRAINING WORKER → MODEL BUNDLE → EXPLICIT ACTIVATION → LIVE CLASSIFICATIONS**

Choose a run to follow epoch progress, optimization and validation. Training panels contain worker-reported observations; no run means no training data. Inference panels measure the running daemon, including its heuristic fallback.

panels.title: Epoch budget used
panels.description: Early stopping can complete successfully below 100%. This is an epoch budget, not a deployment readiness score.

panels.title: Worker elapsed training time
panels.description: Reported worker time; terminal runs retain their last observation.

panels.title: Training and validation loss
panels.description: Cross-entropy for classifiers or reconstruction loss for anomaly models. Compare matching objectives; a lower loss is not proof of detection quality.

panels.title: Validation accuracy & macro F1
panels.description: Held-out validation observations reported by a classifier worker. Not live production accuracy; anomaly runs need not report these metrics.

panels.title: Anomaly reconstruction error
panels.description: Validation reconstruction loss from an anomaly worker. No data is expected for classification-only runs.

panels.title: Learning-rate schedule
panels.description: Latest optimizer learning rate reported per epoch.

panels.title: Seconds since running worker update
panels.description: A worker becomes stale after 15 minutes without a report. Long epochs can also create long gaps.

panels.title: Latest epoch batches
panels.description: Per-epoch gauges; do not apply rate() to these.

panels.title: Runtime model roles
panels.description: Classifier includes heuristic fallback. Registry models and loaded runtime models are separate.

panels.title: Registered neural parameter counts
panels.description: Architecture metadata for the newest 100 registered models.

options.content:
### What is measured
- The worker must use --report-to and, when required, SYNAPSE_API_TOKEN. Metrics appear after the daemon receives an epoch report.
- Gauges retain the latest observation; Prometheus samples by wall clock, so a fast run can finish between scrapes. Use the console for complete retained epoch history.
- Per-run and per-model series cover the newest 100 entries. Aggregate counts include all known runs. Run IDs create new series; set suitable Prometheus retention.
- Hidden activations, gradients, neuron weights, GPU utilization and live detection accuracy are not instrumented. Bundle promotion remains an explicit operator action.
